deviations: Dependency guard vs existing test whitelist (Lead decision option 1, executed across PH-282 and PH-286): PH-274 spec/ADR 0012 freeze manifest requires={contracts,settlement,cash} (and migration_dependencies ['core','contracts','settlement','cash']). PH-282 added 7 affected disable-loop test files and PH-286 added tests/test_v1_contracts.py and tests/test_contract_approval.py to the PH-274 allowed_paths (28 paths total), supplying BASE ddc86d6. This slice rebased onto that BASE, restored the ADR requires/migration_dependencies (registry validates), kept the service-layer dependency gate as defence in depth, and in each of the 9 loops disables onboarding first with minimal edits that do not change business assertion semantics. The earlier temporary requires={} fallback is gone.

No onboarding 0001 migration: the main PH-274 spec freezes no business tables, no ImportPreview/ImportConflict persistence and no migrations/0001_initial.py. The Lead's task message mentioned an own 0001 migration and canonical conflict persistence; the spec was followed (bootstrap app only, in-memory ephemeral conflict projection), and the conflict is disclosed rather than silently changing the contract.

Conflict list is an in-memory ephemeral projection with canonical-like fields (kind=import_conflict, ephemeral=true, row_number/code/field/message/severity) returned per response; nothing is persisted and no ImportPreview/ImportConflict table exists. This satisfies the spec's '不做冲突持久化' while still giving PH-271 a canonical-shaped preview payload.

Auditor HTTP preview: the read-only preview entry import_preview_run is registered as history_read (GET; renders the upload page and can preview a small text content query), while the multipart file upload is a separate business_write route import_preview_upload (owner/finance); the list page remains business_read. This keeps auditor read-only HTTP access (GET run returns 200 and the service layer allows auditor) without granting auditor a write channel. The route split is disclosed because the frozen plugin runtime maps business_write to POST/require_write and history_read to GET.

Preview header mapping is intentionally lenient (required columns must be present; extra columns become unmapped_columns) per the spec's mapped_fields/unmapped requirement, while core.imports.parse_csv remains strict and unchanged; preview does not call the strict parser and performs its own read-only row validation.

Preview performs one generic audit write (onboarding.import_previewed) as the spec allows; it is the only durable write. The generic audit helper also emits its ordinary non-canonical outbox DomainEvent for the action name; no canonical topic/command/schema is added.
Single worker owns the whole write set (onboarding plugin files, settings/delivery wiring, tests, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.
